note: Answer key authored from direct read-only inspection of the local checkouts (plain git + file reads, independent of z0int.state_packet) BEFORE any arm was run. Structural facts only (branch names, commit ids/subjects, paths, session-id prefixes); no conversation text. Questions whose key facts drift during the run are voided by run.py's post-run oracle, never re-keyed.
answer_contract: Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"action": "answer"|"abstain"|"conflict", "fields": {...}, "evidence": ["source pointers you relied on"]}. Use action=abstain when local evidence does not establish the answer; use action=conflict when sources disagree (report each side in fields).

questions.prompt: In the local checkout ~/workspace/z0evals: what branch is checked out, what is the HEAD short sha, and what is the HEAD commit subject?
In ~/workspace/aodl: which branch is checked out, how many tracked files have uncommitted modifications, and which untracked paths exist at the top level?

In ~/workspace/aodl: which local branches have commits that are NOT on origin/main (per the local remote-tracking refs), how many commits ahead is each, and where (which worktree path, if any) is each checked out?
In ~/workspace/aodl: roughly how many days ago were the remote-tracking refs last fetched, and can ahead/behind counts versus origin be trusted as the live remote state without fetching?
In the main checkout ~/workspace/z0intelligence (not its .claude/worktrees): which branch is checked out and what is its upstream tracking ref?
In ~/workspace/z0intelligence: which branch and which worktree path hold the State Packet work?

According to local Claude Code history (~/.claude/projects), which top-level (non-subagent) Claude Code session most recently worked in ~/workspace/z0intelligence? Give the first 8 characters of its session id.
What is the current P0 / critical-path priority for z0intelligence? If local sources (repo docs, git, local Claude Code history) disagree, report each claim with its source instead of picking one.
According to local Claude Code history, what did the most recent Claude Code session whose working directory was ~/workspace/aodl/.worktrees/dash-wired change, and on which branch?

An agent wants to add new files under studies/ in ~/workspace/z0evals. Given the current checkout state and the repository's own rules: may it commit directly on the currently checked-out branch, and may it merge its work into main? What is the required path instead?
